Suspend Etqan's defaults
Stops this academy's use of Etqan's default accounts (email, WhatsApp, video, AI); its own accounts keep working. Allowed once an Etqan invoice is unpaid 30 days after issue; never automatic. No unpaid Etqan invoice.
errors: Etqan's defaults may be suspended only once an Etqan invoice is unpaid 30 days after issue.
